title: Auto Beam
description: An ADVISOR for the high beam: reads the front camera's light objects, the lamps, the stalk, the brightness and the speed (read only), decides with shared/beam_logic.js and shows 'high beam now' or 'dip now' with the reason, the lights ahead and the driver's own lamps, and scores itself against what the driver did. It never switches a lamp and writes nothing to the car.

de.bmw.sensors.objects.RecogFrontCameraL._about: Auto Beam (HD): the front camera's light objects (15 events, 10 UInt8 each, units UNKNOWN: config.inputs.lights / config.algo.lights) and its own verdict (controlHighBeamAssistant). EVENTS only, as broadcasts: no getter, no setter, no method. acknowledgeObjectDataLeft / Right (setter, no getter) are NOT declared and never will be. Whether this car (no option 5AC) sends any of it is unknown: the log's 'beam: src lights first' line answers it.

de.bmw.sensors.objects.RecogFrontCameraO._about: Auto Beam (HD): THE FALLBACK while the light stream is silent (HR: likely on a car without the licence): the camera's object list, up to 20, metres and m/s, per object head-lamp and rear-lamp ON / OFF (event 32770). Read only.

de.bmw.environmentalmodel.ObjectRecognit._about: Auto Beam (HD): the second fallback: the camera's object list with statusMovement ONCOMING / SAME_AS_EGO (40 slots; events 32769, 32770), joined slot by slot with the positions. Read only.

de.bmw.environmentalmodel.SignRecognitio._about: Auto Beam (HD): the built-up area from the camera's own town-entry / town-exit signs (TrafficSignType CITY_LIMIT_START_OF 55, CITY_LIMIT_END_OF 56, CITY_LIMIT_START_END_OF 57; event 32769; seen on the car as the themes' sign source). Navigation is CarPlay: there is no map flag. Read only.

de.bmw.body.Light._about: Auto Beam (HD): the low beam on / off and its brightness (LowBeam, getter 1, notifier 32771); the lamps' commands (LampExterior2, notifier 32772: controlFunctionMainBeam = the high beam lit, ASSUMED; controlFunctionFrontFogLight = the fog lamps); the stalk's bits (IndicatorSteeringColumn, notifier 32773: push / pull ASSUMED 0x20 / 0x10, ROUND.md 1a). Read only: this interface has no setter at all.

de.bmw.body.Environment._about: Auto Beam (HD): the ambient brightness (raw UInt8, unit unknown), notifier 32770. Read only.

de.bmw.body.Wiper._about: Auto Beam (HD): the rain intensity (raw), notifier 32771. Read only.

de.bmw.infotainment.vehicle.Vehicle2._about: Auto Beam (HD): our speed (raw x 0.015625 km/h, getter 8; seen on the car); the number of the car's message shown now (getter 61; seen 2026-11-18: 0 none): while one shows, our cluster picture yields; statusLightStatus (getter 43, notifier 32811): statusMainBeam_headlightFlasher, HR's best candidate for 'the high beam is lit' (unseen yet; trusted only while statusLightStatusError says the signals are in order). Read only.

de.bmw.infotainment.vehicle.Vehicle._about: Auto Beam (HD): the car's own day / night (getter 19, notifier 32787), the sun's stand-in in the algorithm and the night look. Read only.

de.bmw.chassis.YawRateProvision._about: Auto Beam (HD): the yaw rate (event 32791; scale ASSUMED) as the curve proxy. Read only.

de.bmw.dass.TrafficSignRecognition._about: Auto Beam (HD): the speed limit (presentClassLimitSpeed x 5, seen on the car 2026-11-18): a limit of 50 km/h or less counts as a built-up area. Read only.

de.bmw.infotainment.hmi.hmicontext.HMICo._about: the head unit's language for "Авто" (shared/lang.js; getter 3, notifier 32771). Read only.

screens.name: MAIN
screens.title: Auto Beam
screens._about: the app's own page: the scene (both beams on the road, the lights ahead) and the advice on the left, the data table on the right. Nothing on it can be pressed; the only button is the kit's Settings.

settings.label: Показувати на щитку
settings._about: the glance view on the cluster's map target (3 layers on the app's own connection), off by default. contend false, guide_hold 0.

settings.label: Демо
settings._about: the 18 drawn states in turn, then four moving scenes played through the real algorithm (no car signals)

settings.label: Чутливість
settings._about: per driver profile: the dip zones and the return times x config.sens[value]

settings.label: Стежити за рішенням камери
settings._about: whether the camera's own verdict (controlHighBeamAssistant) counts as a dip trigger; it is always shown and logged

layer._about: the map target's core x 334..754, y 44..416: ab_road effect 420 x 260 at (334, 156), ab_lights effect (the same box), text sheet 420 x 112 at (334, 44). contend false: it waits while BMW's map holds the slot. guideHold 0: BMW's CarPlay manoeuvre box is never held back for us.

config._yieldUnknown: statusDisplayedCCMessage 65535 (unknown, seen after a start) does not make our picture yield; any other non-zero number does

inputs._about: inputs.js: the catalogue's defaults mean 'no object'; everything marked assumed is a HYPOTHESIS until a night drive (HS's recorder) settles it: which member says the high beam is lit (highSources: statusLightStatus first, LampExterior2 second, as HR suggests), which stalk bit is the flash pull, the object lists' lateral sign, the wiper level, the yaw rate's scale, how long a town lasts without its exit sign.

algo._about: a partial config for shared/beam_logic.js (docs/highbeam/CONTRACT.md section 4), merged over its DEFAULTS; the sensitivity setting merges B.PRESETS[early | normal | late] over it; 'Стежити за рішенням камери' sets verdict.use follow / log. objects.use fallback: the camera's object lists stand in while the light stream is silent (HR: likely on this car). Every scale of the light objects is the module's own (assumed until a drive).

config._night: 'auto': the car's day / night, else the sun; 'day' / 'night': a fixed look (the bench)
